input_messages.content: Hi there! I was hoping you could help me with an order I placed for my daughter. She hasn’t received it yet, and I’m a bit worried. Could you help me check where it was sent, if it’s still on the way, and maybe give me the tracking number? Also, I wanted to double-check the storage size of the tablet I ordered for her. And, if possible, I’d like to update my default shipping address to my daughter’s address in Chicago, so I don’t have to change it every time.
Sure, my name is Lucas Santos and my zip code is 80239. I actually can’t remember which email I used for the account, sorry about that. Is that enough to find my information?

I don’t have the order ID handy, but I can tell you I ordered a tablet and a couple of other things for my daughter recently—maybe within the last week or so. The tablet was the main thing, and I just want to make sure it has enough storage for her schoolwork.

As for the address, I’d like to set my daughter’s place in Chicago as the default. I can give you her full address if you need it. Let me know what you need from me!

Of course, her address is 1842 West Belmont Avenue, Apartment 3B, Chicago, IL 60657. Please let me know if you need any more details.

By the way, I really appreciate you helping me with this. It’s just me and my daughter, so I always want to make sure things go smoothly for her. Sometimes it gets a bit lonely, you know? Anyway, thanks for taking the time.

Thank you so much for checking all that for me. Yes, that’s the correct address I want to use as my default from now on—1842 West Belmont Avenue, Apartment 3B, Chicago, IL 60657.

I’m a little confused, though. The order was delivered to 943 Maple Drive, Suite 356, but my daughter lives on West Belmont Avenue. Is there any way to find out who signed for the package or if it can be redirected? I just want to make sure she gets it, since she’s been waiting for it.

And thanks again for your help. It’s nice to have someone to talk to, even if it’s just about orders and addresses.

Thank you for updating the address for me—I really appreciate it. I’ll reach out to the delivery service with the tracking number and see if they can help me figure out what happened.

I guess sometimes things just get mixed up, but it’s a bit stressful when you’re trying to do something nice for someone you care about. Anyway, thanks for listening and for all your help today. It’s nice to have someone on the other end who’s patient.

That’s all I needed for now. Have a good day! 

###STOP###
